result.title: LightCRS: Lightweight Multi-Domain Conversational Recommendation System
result.summary: Conversational recommender systems have recently adopted vision-language models to match user dialogue intents with multimodal product information. However, extending these methods to many product domains faces a dilemma: deploying a separately adapted VLM per domain scales cost linearly with the number of domains and requires routing each dialogue to the right model, while naively merging all domains into a single VLM degrades accuracy because product characteristics vary widely across categories. We propose LightCRS, a lightweight, query-conditioned framework for unified multi-domain multimodal conversational recommendation. LightCRS precomputes multimodal product representations once offline with frozen encoders. Online, a compact 5.3M-parameter module fuses this evidence for each dialogue via query-conditioned cross-attention, whose parameters are shared across all domains, and compares candidates jointly with an inter-candidate Transformer. To enable rigorous evaluation, we construct MM-R2A-25, a 25-domain benchmark pairing natural Reddit recommendation-seeking conversations with Amazon product listings. LightCRS achieves state-of-the-art average HR@1, NDCG@5, and MRR, improving HR@1 by 35.4\% over the strongest baseline while reducing per-query latency by 266 times. Joint multi-domain training itself improves HR@1 by 15.2\% over separately trained single-domain models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LightCRS：用冻结编码器离线预计算多模态商品表示，在线由共享的 5.3M 参数模块以 query-conditioned cross-attention 融合证据并用候选间 Transformer 联合比较，实现跨 25 个领域的多模态对话推荐，并构建 MM-R2A-25 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按对话意图从大量预计算多模态表示中以小参数交叉注意力筛证据、再联合比较候选」的做法，可供核查是否可迁移为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与低成本证据融合模块；但论文本身只做推荐排序，未涉及 latent 推理状态或获取证据与停止决策。
